By giving sadaqah, one is not only providing for the physical needs of others but also purifying their own soul. Giving with a sincere heart and intentions pleases God, and it's a form of worship that continues even after death as the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) said, "Save yourself from Hell by giving even a morsel of food in the way of Allah."
